correctness.rationale: Uniform proof: rational-line Hermitian zeros all Fq² or full generators; conjugate span descends and has rank three; cyclic Gram matrix and norm normalization show transitivity under PGU(4,q); stabilizer quotient is cyclic q³+1; independent Hermitian-plane section count and known unitary group order agree. Complete q=2 finite-field enumeration gives 2880 off-line F64 points and 40 secant planes of 72 each. Maximal cohomology plus line incidence implies extension counts; finite experiment is not used to prove general q.

originality.rationale: The novel core is the transitive degree-three PGU(4,q) action on the Hermitian surface's generator complement, the cyclic exact stabilizer, and the unique secant-plane decomposition; classical generator and extension point-count facts are expressly excluded from novelty. Six mathematical-record queries and full-text comparisons did not exhibit the core; older unitary orbit literature remains a substantial residual priority risk.
residual_risks: Older finite unitary group orbit and polar space literature may contain an equivalent point-orbit classification using nonmatching terminology.
The full-text comparison to Homma–Kim and Napolitano covered only abstract/theorem material, so no whole-document absence claim is made.
No independently commissioned priority or mathematical audit has been performed.

value.rationale: The complement of every geometric generator is a canonical arithmetic open surface. Its first closed-point degree, complete first nonempty PGU orbit and exact cyclic stabilizer are natural group-arithmetic invariants; the unique smooth-section plane through each degree-three point gives a structural partition and facilitates further orbit and finite-field coding questions. No arbitrary small characteristic or parameter slice is imposed.
